problems.title: Two Sum
problems.description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution.

problems.title: Add Two Numbers
problems.description: You are given two non-empty linked lists representing two non-negative integers. The digits are stored in reverse order, and each node contains a single digit. Add the two numbers and return the sum as a linked list.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters using a sliding window approach.

problems.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
problems.description: Given two sorted arrays nums1 and nums2, return the median of the two sorted arrays. The overall run time complexity should be O(log(m+n)).

problems.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
problems.description: Given a string s, return the longest palindromic substring in s. A palindrome reads the same forward and backward.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.description: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. An input string is valid if open brackets are closed by the same type and in the correct order.

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.description: Merge two sorted linked lists and return it as a sorted list. The list should be made by splicing together the nodes of the first two lists.

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.description: Given an integer array nums, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum. Use Kadane's algorithm for optimal solution.

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.description: You are climbing a staircase. It takes n steps to reach the top. Each time you can either climb 1 or 2 steps. In how many distinct ways can you climb to the top?

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problems.description: You are given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a given stock on the ith day. Maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy and a single day to sell.

problems.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
problems.description: Given the root of a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes' values from left to right, level by level.

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.description: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is a valid binary search tree. A valid BST is defined such that the left subtree contains only nodes with keys less than the node's key.

problems.title: Invert Binary Tree
problems.description: Given the root of a binary tree, invert the tree and return its root. Swap all left and right children recursively.

problems.title: Network Delay Time
problems.description: You are given a network of n nodes. Given times, a list of travel times as directed edges, find the time it takes for all nodes to receive the signal sent from node k. Uses Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm.

problems.title: Course Schedule
problems.description: There are a total of numCourses courses you have to take. Some courses may have prerequisites. Return true if you can finish all courses. This is a cycle detection problem in a directed graph.

problems.title: Number of Islands
problems.description: Given an m x n 2D binary grid which represents a map of land and water, return the number of islands. An island is surrounded by water and is formed by connecting adjacent lands horizontally or vertically.

problems.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
problems.description: A trie or prefix tree is a tree data structure used to efficiently store and retrieve keys in a dataset of strings. Implement the Trie class with insert, search, and startsWith methods.

problems.title: Word Search
problems.description: Given an m x n grid of characters board and a string word, return true if word exists in the grid. The word can be constructed from letters of sequentially adjacent cells using backtracking.

problems.title: Merge Intervals
problems.description: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [starti, endi], merge all overlapping intervals, and return an array of the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input.

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.description: You are given an integer array coins representing coins of different denominations and an integer amount. Return the fewest number of coins needed to make up that amount using dynamic programming.

problems.title: Minimum Spanning Tree
problems.description: Find the minimum spanning tree of a weighted undirected graph. The MST connects all vertices with the minimum total edge weight using Kruskal's or Prim's algorithm.

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.description: Given a sorted array of integers and a target value, return the index of target using binary search. If target is not found, return -1. Binary search runs in O(log n) time.

problems.title: LRU Cache
problems.description: Design a data structure that follows the constraints of a Least Recently Used cache. Implement with O(1) time complexity for both get and put operations using a hash map and doubly linked list.

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
problems.description: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map, compute how much water it can trap after raining. Can be solved using two pointers or stack-based approach.

problems.title: Word Break
problems.description: Given a string s and a dictionary of strings wordDict, return true if s can be segmented into space-separated sequence of dictionary words. Uses dynamic programming or BFS approach.

problems.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
problems.description: Design an algorithm to serialize and deserialize a binary tree. Serialization is converting a tree to a string and deserialization is reconstructing the tree from the string.

problems.title: Find Median from Data Stream
problems.description: Design a data structure that supports addNum to add an integer and findMedian to return the median of all elements. Implement using two heaps for O(log n) insertion.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.description: Given an integer array nums, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence. Can be solved with DP in O(n^2) or binary search in O(n log n).

problems.title: Rotate Image
problems.description: You are given an n x n 2D matrix representing an image. Rotate the image by 90 degrees clockwise in-place without allocating another 2D matrix.

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
problems.description: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the kth largest element. Solve using a min-heap of size k for O(n log k) time or quickselect for O(n) average.

problems.title: Graph Valid Tree
problems.description: Given n nodes labeled from 0 to n-1 and a list of undirected edges, determine if these edges make up a valid tree. A valid tree is a connected acyclic graph.

problems.title: Word Ladder
problems.description: Given two words, beginWord and endWord, and a dictionary wordList, return the number of words in the shortest transformation sequence. Each transformation changes one letter at a time.

problems.title: Min Stack
problems.description: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant time. Each operation should be O(1).

problems.title: Product of Array Except Self
problems.description: Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is equal to the product of all the elements of nums except nums[i], without using the division operation in O(n) time.

problems.title: Alien Dictionary
problems.description: Given a sorted dictionary of an alien language, find the order of characters. This is a topological sort problem on a directed graph built from adjacent words.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.description: Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice in the array. Use a hash set for O(n) time and O(n) space solution.

problems.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
problems.description: Given an m x n matrix of heights, find all cells that can flow water to both the Pacific and Atlantic oceans. Water can flow to neighboring cells with equal or lower height.

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.description: Given two strings text1 and text2, return the length of their longest common subsequence. A subsequence is a sequence derived by deleting some characters without changing order.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.description: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list. Can be solved iteratively or recursively.

problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.description: Given the root of a binary tree, return its maximum depth. The maximum depth is the number of nodes along the longest path from the root node down to the farthest leaf node.

problems.title: Dijkstra's Shortest Path
problems.description: Find the shortest path from a source vertex to all other vertices in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights using Dijkstra's algorithm with a priority queue.

problems.title: Merge K Sorted Lists
problems.description: Merge k sorted linked lists and return it as one sorted list. Use a min-heap to efficiently select the smallest element across all lists in O(N log k) time.

problems.title: Group Anagrams
problems.description: Given an array of strings, group anagrams together. Anagrams are words formed by rearranging the letters. Use sorted string or character count as hash key.

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of Binary Tree
problems.description: Given a binary tree, find the lowest common ancestor of two given nodes. The LCA is the deepest node that is an ancestor of both nodes.

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.description: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements. Use a bucket sort or heap for O(n) or O(n log k) solution.

problems.title: House Robber
problems.description: Given an integer array nums representing money at each house, return the maximum amount you can rob without robbing two adjacent houses. Classic dynamic programming problem.

problems.title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
problems.description: Design a data structure that supports adding new words and searching for words with wildcards. The search can contain '.' which matches any letter. Implement using a Trie with DFS.

problems.title: Subsets
problems.description: Given an integer array nums of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set). The solution must not contain duplicate subsets. Use backtracking or bit manipulation.

problems.title: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
problems.description: Given an n x n binary matrix grid, return the length of the shortest clear path from top-left to bottom-right. A clear path is one that contains only 0s. Use BFS for shortest path.

problems.title: Task Scheduler
problems.description: Given a character array tasks representing CPU tasks and a cooling interval n, return the least number of intervals the CPU will take to finish all tasks. Uses greedy with priority queue.
